kṛtameva daivanirāsena
pauruṣaprādhānyasamarthanamudāharaṇapratyudāharaṇairdṛḍhīkariṣyannadhikā
riṇo hitopadeśopapattibhiḥ puruṣārthe avatārayati - prāpyeti
anicchataḥ kathaṃ yatnaḥ syāditi tatrecchāvaśyakatvamāha - daivamiti

pratyakṣapauruṣaviruddhaṃ daivaṃ pratyācikhyāsuḥ pauruṣasya pratyakṣasiddhaṃ
svarūpamāha - saṃvitspanda ityādinā

saṃvitspandaḥ
puruṣārthatatsādhanasphūrtistena tatsādhanecchāyatno manaḥ spandastena
karmendriyāṇāmaṅgacālanāya pravṛttiraindriyaspandaḥ

yatra yatra phale laukike vaidike vā yathā yathā pauruṣamupayujyate dhyānādau
mānasameva pradhānamāsanamaune tadaṅge

yātrādau tu kāyikameva pradhānaṃ
vāṅmanoniyamau tadaṅge

kvacittu dvayordvayoḥ prādhānyaṃ
kvacittrayāṇāmiti tatra tatra tathā tathā tatpauruṣamābālaṃ bālānabhivyāpya
saṃsiddhaṃ pratyakṣasiddhaṃ daivaṃ tu na kvaciddṛṣṭamityasadevetyarthaḥ

laukikāḥs vata eva yāgādayaḥ svataḥ śāstrataśca jñānaṃ tu svataḥ śāstrato
gurutaśceti trisiddhayaḥ

somena yajeta
ityādivākyabodhitayāgānāṃ vyāpārajanyatvādbhāvanānāṃ ca
puruṣapravṛttinimitatvātpravṛtteśca parispandarūpatvāt

yadi daive mahatī bhaktistarhi pauruṣameva daivabuddhyāvalambyatāṃ
natvasatkalpanamanyadityabhipretyāha - puruṣārthādityādinā

nanu svargādilokasthaṃ daivamihādarśanena nāpalapituṃ śakyaṃ tatrāha -
neti

anyo vyāpāraścāṅgāntarāṇāṃ
pauruṣeṇaiva na daivato dṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ

kvacittu kriyāyāḥ spandadharmiṇyāḥ iti
pāṭhastatra kriyāyāḥ svārthasādhakatā prasiddheti tatphalabhūtayā dhiyā
svayamunnīyate uddhriyata ityarthaḥ

samatā ajñānakṛtavaiṣamyanivṛttistadupalakṣitamānandaṃ ye viduḥ sa
cānando yebhyaḥ prāpyate te savyāḥ
praṇipātaparipraśnaśuśrūṣādibhirabhyāsena cāvarjanīyāḥ

tathā tadvivṛddhaye ciraṃ yatnaḥ kārya iti vaktumuktameva punarāha -
ābālyāditi
puruṣakāraḥ pauruṣaṃ tadeva puruṣārthakāraṇaṃ yasmiṃstathāvidhe jagati
